blocks.label: Prep
blocks.note: The opening three weeks of the written base phase, before the strength block.

blocks.label: Strength

blocks.label: Arc
blocks.note: The 26-week build to the race: base, build, race-specific, taper.

mon.title: Technique swim
mon.effort: Easy throughout. Technique is the point, not the distance.
detail: Alternative: full rest, if last week was hard.
Pick ONE cue for the whole session.

tue.title: Easy-steady bike
detail: Conversational the whole way.
The most common way to ruin base is letting this drift into moderately hard.

wed.title: Main swim
wed.effort: Steady - repeatable. Same pace on the last rep as the first.
detail: Count strokes per length on the main set.
If the count climbs more than 3-4 from first rep to last, the stroke is falling apart - note when.

wed.title: Brick run off the swim
detail: Short on purpose. Do not extend it.

thu.title: Easy run + strides
detail: Finish with 6 x 20s strides.
Strides are relaxed accelerations, not sprints. Smooth, controlled, no straining.

fri.title: Strength
fri.effort: Light. Durability work, not a lifting program.
detail: Two rounds, minimal rest between exercises, 90s between rounds.
If it is making Saturday worse, cut it.

sat.title: Long ride
sat.effort: Zone 2 - 65-75% max HR. Yes, even the long one.
detail: The anchor session of the week.

mon.title: GVT - Chest
mon.effort: 90 sec rest between sets. Same weight for all ten sets - pick something you could do 20 reps with.
setLines: Push Ups - 15 every minute on the minute for 10 min (150 total)
detail: Before work.

tue.title: Lower Body
setLines: Leg Extension Tri-Set - 4 rounds of 12 / 8 / AMRAP (15 sec between, stay in the chair; 90 sec between rounds)
SUPERSET 4×: Barbell Walking Lunges 15 + Barbell Squats AMRAP
detail: Before work.

tue.title: Technique swim
tue.effort: Easy throughout. Technique is the point, not the distance.
detail: Evening. Your legs are wrecked from this morning - that is the point of swimming today.
Pick ONE cue for the whole session.

wed.title: GVT - Back
wed.effort: 90 sec rest between sets. Same weight for all ten sets.
setLines: SUPERSET 4×: Pull Ups AMRAP + Lat Pulldowns 10-12
SUPERSET 4×: DB Curl 6-8 + Hammer Curl AMRAP (same weight)
detail: Before work.

thu.title: Lower Body
thu.effort: Volume day. Nothing here should be a grinder.
setLines: Overhead Walking Lunges 4×15 (25 or 45 lb plate overhead)
detail: Before work.

thu.title: Aerobic swim
thu.effort: Steady and repeatable. Same pace on the last rep as the first.
setLines: 10 × 100 alternating: odd steady, even easy - 15s rest
detail: Evening.

fri.title: Shoulders / Arms
fri.effort: Moderate. Nothing to failure except where it says AMRAP.
setLines: SUPERSET 4×: Arnold Press 8 + DB Shoulder Press AMRAP
detail: Before work.

sat.title: Easy ride
sat.effort: Zone 2 - 65-75% max HR. Conversational the whole way.
detail: Maintenance only. This does not progress during the GVT block.
If your legs are still wrecked from Thursday, ride it easier - do not skip it.

sun.title: Easy run
detail: Optional. Full rest is the right call if the week beat you up.

mon.title: Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
mon.effort: Moderate volume. Leave one rep in the tank on the pressing.
setLines: TRI-SET 3 rounds: Upright BB Rows 15-20 + Side Laterals 12-15 + DB Shrugs 15-20
detail: Before work.

tue.title: Lower Body
tue.effort: Work up to the heavy triple, then back off.
detail: Before work.

tue.title: Technique swim
tue.effort: Easy throughout. Technique is the point, not the distance.
detail: Evening. Your legs are wrecked from this morning - that is the point of swimming today.
Pick ONE cue for the whole session.

wed.title: Back & Biceps
wed.effort: Deadlifts at 80% 1RM. Everything after is accessory.
setLines: SUPERSET 3×: Pendlay Rows 8-10 + DB Row 10-12 (two hands at once)
SUPERSET 4×: Preacher Curl 10-12 + Rope Concentration Curl 12-15
detail: Before work.

thu.title: Lower Body
thu.effort: Posterior chain focus. Hinge, do not squat, the hip thrusts.
detail: Before work.

thu.title: Aerobic swim
thu.effort: Steady and repeatable. Same pace on the last rep as the first.
setLines: 10 × 100 alternating: odd steady, even easy - 15s rest
detail: Evening.

fri.title: Chest / Back
fri.effort: Bench at 75% 1RM. Alternate push and pull throughout.
setLines: Push Ups - 15 every minute on the minute for 10 min
detail: Before work.

sat.title: Easy ride
sat.effort: Zone 2 - 65-75% max HR. Conversational the whole way.
detail: Maintenance only. This does not progress during the GVT block.
If your legs are still wrecked from Thursday, ride it easier - do not skip it.

sun.title: Easy run
detail: Optional. Full rest is the right call if the week beat you up.

mon.title: Legs
mon.effort: Main sets first, then the power sets. Bar speed is the intent, not grinding.
setLines: Barbell Squat {power} - bar speed on every rep
SUPERSET 4×: Leg Curls 12-15 + Stiff Legged Deadlifts 10-12
Overhead Walking Lunges 3×15 (25 or 45 lb plate)
Leg Extension Tri-Set - 4 rounds of 12 / 8 / AMRAP
detail: Before work.
Legs go on Monday so they have five days to clear before Saturday's long ride.

tue.title: Aerobic swim
tue.effort: Steady and repeatable. Same pace on the last rep as the first.
setLines: 10 × 100 alternating: odd steady, even easy - 15s rest
detail: Evening.

wed.title: Pull
wed.effort: Main sets first, then the power sets. Bar speed is the intent.
setLines: Deadlift {power} - bar speed on every rep
SUPERSET 4×: Weighted Pull Ups AMRAP + Lat Pulldown 10-12
detail: Before work.

thu.title: Easy run
thu.effort: Zone 2 - conversational. No strides, no pickups.
detail: Evening.
The first running in eight weeks - expect it to feel worse than your fitness suggests. That is normal and it passes in a fortnight.

fri.title: Push
fri.effort: Main sets first, then the power sets. Bar speed is the intent.
setLines: Bench Press {power} - bar speed on every rep
SUPERSET 3×: Skull Crushers 12-15 + Overhead Tricep Ext 10-12
Push Ups - 100 total as fast as possible
detail: Before work.
Push goes on Friday because it barely touches the legs before Saturday.

sat.title: Long ride
sat.effort: Zone 2 - 65-75% max HR. Yes, even the long one.
detail: The anchor session of the week. This is where the aerobic base comes back.

sun.title: Long run
detail: Off the back of the ride. Run it by effort, not pace.

mon.title: Strength
mon.effort: RPE 7 - two or three reps in the tank, nothing to failure. A 30-minute session is a light week: one fewer set on every lift.
detail: Before work.
This keeps what the lifting block built. It is not a lifting program.

mon.title: Technique swim
mon.effort: Easy throughout. Technique is the point, not the distance.
setLines: 8 × 50 drill - 20s rest (rotate: fingertip drag, catch-up, single-arm, 6-3-6)
detail: Evening. Optional - but do it unless you are genuinely wrecked. Swim frequency is the cheapest speed a newer swimmer can buy.
Pick ONE cue for the whole session.

tue.title: {tueTitle}
detail: On the trainer, Zone 2 is 56-75% FTP. Without power, ride it by heart rate and breathing.
Warm up 10-15 min easy before any efforts; spin easy to the full time.

wed.title: Main swim
wed.effort: Steady sets hold the same pace on the last rep as the first. CSS is your pace per 100 m from the last test.
detail: Count strokes per length on the main set.
If the count climbs more than 3-4 from first rep to last, the stroke is falling apart - note when.

wed.title: Run off the swim
detail: Straight from the pool. Do not extend it.

thu.title: {thuTitle}
detail: Strides are relaxed accelerations to about 5K effort, not sprints. Walk back between.
The most common way to ruin base is letting easy running drift into moderately hard.

fri.title: Aerobic swim
fri.effort: Steady and continuous. The easy day before the big weekend - keep it that way.

sat.title: Long ride
detail: The anchor session of the week.
Indoors there is no coasting, so it is harder per minute than it looks. If it has to shrink, keep any Zone 3 work and cut the easy tail.

sun.title: Long run
detail: Run it by effort, not pace.

fuel.longRide: 60-75g carb/hr, starting at 30 min. Start using the products you plan to race with.
fuel.longRun: Water for the first hour, then 30-45g carb/hr.

mon.title: Strength
mon.effort: RPE 7 - two or three reps in the tank, nothing to failure. A 30-minute session is a light week: one fewer set on every lift.
detail: Before work.
If Tuesday's intervals suffer, move the squats and RDLs to Tuesday, after the ride.

mon.title: Technique swim
mon.effort: Easy throughout. Technique is the point, not the distance.
setLines: 8 × 50 drill - 20s rest (rotate: fingertip drag, catch-up, single-arm, 6-3-6)
detail: Evening. Optional - but do it unless you are genuinely wrecked. Swim frequency is the cheapest speed a newer swimmer can buy.
Pick ONE cue for the whole session.

tue.title: {tueTitle}
detail: Zone 4 is 88-95% FTP - ERG mode on the trainer holds it for you. By heart rate it is 83-89% max, but bike HR runs 5-10 bpm low, so trust RPE 7.
Warm up 15 min easy, building, before the first interval; spin easy to the full time.

wed.title: Main swim
wed.effort: Steady sets hold the same pace on the last rep as the first. CSS is your pace per 100 m from the last test.
detail: Count strokes per length on the main set.
If the count climbs more than 3-4 from first rep to last, the stroke is falling apart - note when.

wed.title: Run off the swim
detail: Straight from the pool. Do not extend it.

thu.title: {thuTitle}
detail: Zone 4 is 83-89% max HR, or just under the HR from your last run test. Even effort: the last rep looks like the first.
Warm up 15 min easy before the first interval; jog easy to the full time.

fri.title: Aerobic swim
fri.effort: Steady and continuous. The easy day before the big weekend - keep it that way.
detail: Non-stop means non-stop: slow down rather than stop.

sat.title: Long ride
detail: The anchor session of the week. Put the Zone 3 blocks in the middle hours, not the first.
Build time in the aero position: 10-minute blocks, working toward 30 and more.
Indoors: if it has to shrink, keep the Zone 3 work and cut the easy tail.

sat.title: Brick run
sat.effort: Easy - short, quick steps for the first 5 min. Wooden legs are normal and pass.
detail: Running within 5 minutes of getting off the bike. That transition is the whole point.

sun.title: Long run
detail: Run it by effort, not pace.

fuel.longRide: 75-90g carb/hr from 30 min - the exact products you'll race with. This is gut training; build up to it.
fuel.longRun: 30-45g carb/hr - a gel every 30-40 min, as on race day.

mon.title: Strength
mon.effort: RPE 6 - crisp, fast reps. Nothing heavy, nothing to failure.
detail: Before work.
Recovery week: one set of each, and call it done.

mon.title: Technique swim
mon.effort: Easy throughout. Technique is the point, not the distance.
setLines: 8 × 50 drill - 20s rest (rotate: fingertip drag, catch-up, single-arm, 6-3-6)
detail: Evening. Optional - but do it unless you are genuinely wrecked. Swim frequency is the cheapest speed a newer swimmer can buy.
Pick ONE cue for the whole session.

tue.title: {tueTitle}
detail: Zone 4 is 88-95% FTP; race effort is 70-75% FTP, RPE 5. Bike HR runs 5-10 bpm low - trust power, then RPE.
Warm up 15 min easy, building, before the first interval; spin easy to the full time.

wed.title: Main swim
wed.effort: Race effort is CSS+5 to +8 per 100 m - steady enough to breathe every 2-3 strokes the whole way.
detail: Sight on the main set: lift your eyes forward every 6th stroke, crocodile-style, without lifting your head.

wed.title: Run off the swim
detail: Straight from the pool. Do not extend it.

thu.title: {thuTitle}
detail: Race effort is what you could hold for about two hours fresh - mid Zone 3, RPE 6. On race day you hold it after three hours on the bike.
Warm up 10-15 min easy first; jog easy to the full time.

fri.title: Aerobic swim
fri.effort: Steady and continuous, sighting as you go. The easy day before the big weekend.
detail: Open water: never alone, and with a tow float.

sat.title: Long ride
detail: Race-effort blocks go exactly as you'll race: aero position, race nutrition, race kit when you can.
Indoors: if it has to shrink, keep the race-effort work and cut the easy tail.

sat.title: Brick run
detail: Running within 5 minutes of getting off the bike.
Practise race-run fuelling on the longer ones: a gel at 20-30 min.

sun.title: Long run
detail: Run it by effort, not pace. The day after a big Saturday the pace will be slow - that is the point.

fuel.longRide: 75-90g carb/hr from 30 min - the exact products you'll race with. This is gut training; build up to it.
fuel.longRun: 30-45g carb/hr - a gel every 30-40 min, as on race day.

mon.title: Strength
mon.effort: Bodyweight only - two rounds, nothing hard. This is staying loose, not training.
detail: Before work.

mon.title: Technique swim
mon.effort: Easy throughout. Technique is the point, not the distance.
setLines: 8 × 50 drill - 20s rest (rotate: fingertip drag, catch-up, single-arm, 6-3-6)
detail: Evening. Optional - but do it unless you are genuinely wrecked. Swim frequency is the cheapest speed a newer swimmer can buy.
Pick ONE cue for the whole session.

tue.title: Race-effort bike
tue.effort: 3 × 8 min at race effort - 70-75% FTP, RPE 5. 4 min easy between.
detail: Taper: the volume drops, the intensity doesn't. Feeling flat or twitchy this week is normal.

wed.title: Main swim
wed.effort: Race effort - CSS+5 to +8 per 100 m. Sharp, not tired.

wed.title: Run off the swim
detail: Straight from the pool. Do not extend it.

thu.title: Race-effort run
thu.effort: 3 × 6 min at race effort - mid Zone 3, RPE 6. 2 min jog between.
detail: Warm up 10-15 min easy first; jog easy to the full time.

fri.title: Aerobic swim
fri.effort: Easy, with a little speed at the end.
setLines: MAIN SET: 5 × 100 easy-steady, then 4 × 50 fast - 20s rest
detail: Open water if you can get it, never alone.

sat.title: Long ride
sat.effort: 2 × 15 min race effort - inside a Zone 2 ride, 70-75% FTP, RPE 5.
detail: The last ride with any length to it. Race kit, race nutrition.

sat.title: Brick run
sat.effort: First 10 min at race effort, then easy.
detail: Running within 5 minutes of getting off the bike.

sun.title: Long run
sun.effort: Zone 2 with 4 × 3 min at race effort - 2 min easy between.
detail: Run it by effort, not pace.

fuel.longRide: Race: 60-90g carb/hr - whatever you trained - with 500-750ml fluid/hr and electrolytes, more in the heat. Eat every 20 min on a timer.
fuel.longRun: Race: a gel or on-course carbs every ~30 min. Water at every aid station.

tue.title: Openers
tue.effort: 3 × 3 min at race effort - 3 min easy between, then spin easy.
detail: Short and sharp. You are reminding your legs, not training them.

wed.title: Main swim
wed.effort: Race effort on the 100s, easy everything else.

thu.title: Shakeout run
detail: Travel day if you need it.
Carb load starts today.

fri.title: Shakeout ride
fri.effort: Easy - 20 min with 3 × 1 min at race effort.
detail: Bike check-in. Then feet up.

fri.title: Venue swim
fri.effort: Easy - a few minutes to feel the water, if the venue allows it.

sat.title: Race swim
sat.effort: Steady, not hard - start at the side or back of your wave. Sight every 6-8 strokes.
detail: Sub-7 budget: about 45 min. The effort matters; the clock doesn't.

sat.title: Race bike
sat.effort: Race effort and no higher - 70-75% FTP, RPE 5. Ride the first 20 min easy.
detail: If you're passing people on the climbs, you're riding too hard.
Eat every 20 minutes, on a timer.
Sub-7 budget: about 3:20.

sat.title: Race run
sat.effort: Ease into it - the first 5 km at the bottom of race effort. It will feel too easy; then settle in.
detail: Walk the aid stations if that's what it takes to eat and drink.
Sub-7 budget: about 2:25. Sub-7 is the sum of the legs, not a target for any one of them.

6 x 100 on ONE cue only - 20s rest

warmup: 4 x 50 build easy to moderate - 15s rest
cooldown: 4 x 50 pull buoy, high elbow - 15s rest

friMixed: 10 x 100 alternating: odd steady, even easy - 15s rest
strength: Single-leg Romanian deadlift x 8 each side

cues.name: Exhale, don't hold
cues.detail: Steady bubbles the whole time your face is in the water. Breath-holding is what causes the panic-breathing spiral.

cues.name: Look down
cues.detail: Eyes at the bottom of the pool, slight pressure through the chest. Head lifts as you tire, hips sink, drag.

cues.name: Long in front
cues.detail: Reach, brief glide, finish past the hip. Tired means shortening and spinning the arms.

cues.name: Quiet legs
cues.detail: Small kick from the hip. The kick's job is body position, not propulsion.

big.label: Big day
big.approach: Maintenance or slightly above. Fuel during the session.

moderate.label: Moderate day
moderate.approach: ~300-400 kcal deficit. Carbs concentrated around training.

low.label: Low day
low.approach: ~500 kcal deficit. Protein high, carbs lower.

lift.label: Lifting day
lift.approach: Maintenance calories. Protein 1.8-2.2 g/kg. Do not run a deficit while ramping strength.

key.label: Quality day
key.approach: Maintenance calories. Carbs before and after the session - intervals run on glycogen. No deficit today.

maintain.label: Maintenance day
maintain.approach: Maintenance calories, no deficit. Weight should hold steady from here to race day.

carbLoad.label: Carb load
carbLoad.approach: 7-10g carb per kg bodyweight. Cut fibre and fat so it fits. Nothing new.

race.label: Race day
race.approach: Breakfast about 3 hours before the start: 1-2g carb per kg, food you've eaten before every long ride. Then the plan you rehearsed. Nothing new today.

nonNegotiables: Protein 1.6-2.0 g/kg bodyweight, in 3-4 feedings of 25-40g.
Water throughout, plus replacing session losses.
Cap alcohol, especially Friday and Saturday.

fuel.longRun: Water for the first hour, then 20-30g carb/hr.
fuel.post: After the long ride, long run, or the Wednesday brick: ~1g carb/kg + 25-30g protein within an hour. After anything else, just the next normal meal - no extra recovery snack.
